answer: Will registration with probate office record is the check: a will lodged with the probate office years ago. A farm faking 260 aliases needs 260 separate will records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The beacon check runs in the open: 260 fakes pay the full price 260 times, one honest agent pays once, and the anchor trail in the ledger makes the wharf cost visible to everyone.
